cases.title: 2-byte encoding
cases.verification_rule: Bytes high nibble=opcode; low nibble=register. Reserved bits and length rejected.

cases.title: two-pass symbolic assembly
cases.fixture: LDI R0,3; LOOP: OUT R0,0; ADDI R0,255; JNZ R0,LOOP; HALT
cases.verification_rule: Assembler resolves LOOP to byte address 2; output is 3,2,1.

cases.title: unsigned 8-bit wrap
cases.verification_rule: Result 0 and carry 1, no signed overflow.

cases.title: NAND-only circuit
cases.verification_rule: Every truth table satisfies s + 2cout = a + b + carry.

cases.title: register-to-RAM-to-register
cases.fixture: LDI R3,77; STORE R3,200; LOAD R2,200; HALT

cases.title: microcoded vs atomic spec
cases.fixture:
LDI R0, 5
    ADDI R0, 7
    STORE R0, 0
    XORI R0, 3
    OUT R0, 0
    HALT
cases.verification_rule: Two execution models have identical architectural snapshots after every commit.

cases.title: deterministic input and output
cases.fixture:
IN R1, 1
    ADDI R1, 2
    STORE R1, 4
    LOAD R3, 4
    OUT R3, 2
    HALT
cases.verification_rule: Input tape {port 1:[7]} -> output {port 2:9}, one input consumed.

cases.title: input exhaustion trap
cases.verification_rule: No register, RAM, flag, PC, cursor or I/O mutation.

cases.title: bounded branch loop
cases.fixture:
LDI R0, 3
loop:
    OUT R0, 0
    ADDI R0, 255 ; decrement modulo 256
    JNZ R0, loop
    HALT
cases.verification_rule: Output port 0 events 3,2,1 in order; halts.

cases.title: bounded non-halting program
cases.verification_rule: Run returns non-halted after supplied finite instruction budget.

cases.title: reserved-byte rejection
cases.verification_rule: Nonzero reserved HALT operand refused before execution.

cases.title: branch target alignment
cases.verification_rule: Odd byte address refused by assembler and ROM validator.

cases.title: deterministic power-on reset
cases.verification_rule: No physical power-on reset, SRAM retention or clock is modeled.

cases.title: CMP updates flags without changing selected register
cases.verification_rule: CMP Z=1 but R0 remains 5; JZ still tests register, not flag.

cases.title: disassembler/assembler byte identity
cases.verification_rule: Round-trip preserves exact ROM byte sequence for valid images.

cases.title: evidence-gated physical reconstruction
cases.fixture: six process steps, 12 evidence types missing
cases.verification_rule: Software succeeds while manufactured CPU status remains HOLD.

cases.title: source card vs authenticated primary file
cases.verification_rule: No original publisher technical bytes authenticated or certified by a reviewer.
